CustomField.description: Ticked by an administrator to show a failed call in the Dead Letters list as given up on. It does not stop a scheduled retry, and Retry does not read it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to show this call in the Dead Letters list as one you have given up on. It does not stop a retry that is already scheduled. To run an outgoing call again, untick it and set Status to Queued.
CustomField.label: Manual Dead Letter
